candidates.change_summary: Move the external call to msg.sender to occur before zeroing the caller's credit (introduces a reentrancy vulnerability that can change final credit/balance observed after withdrawAll).
Do not decrement contract balance when withdrawing (balance remains higher after withdrawAll), altering observable state.
Set the caller's credit to oCredit instead of zero (prevents clearing credit, so state after withdrawAll differs).
Invert the conditional to perform withdrawal only when oCredit == 0 (changes whether withdraw happens and thus observable state).
Require the external call to succeed before updating balance and clearing credit (so failure leaves state unchanged; observable difference).
